headline: BNR exchange rate, 8 October 2026. Euro, pound sterling and Swiss franc fall while the dollar rises
summary: The National Bank of Romania published its reference exchange rates for 8 October 2026, showing the euro, pound sterling and Swiss franc falling while the dollar rose.
why: The National Bank of Romania sets the reference rate for the leu, which underpins pricing for cross-border trade and foreign currency lending.
